dedupe_keys.name: 国土数値情報 上水道関連施設 ー drinking water supply series on g spatial information center

description: 国土数値情報(上水道関連施設)ー [drinking water supply] (series on G-spatial Information Center) is a series of datasets listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 不動産・建設経済局. 上水道関連施設として、給水区域および浄水場の位置情報を整備したものである。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 46 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 不動産・建設経済局. Its tags are デジタルシティ, 国交DPF, 国土数値情報, 富山県. It offers 2 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2024-10-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
